scores.claim_text: Astera owns eight issued U.S. patents and 24 pending patent applications as of Feb 1, 2024, generally relating to interconnect and memory control technology.
scores.M_value: 36 applications filed pre-cutoff under assignee 'Astera Labs, Inc.'; 28 of them categorized to interconnect/memory; titles are exactly on-thesis (LOW-LATENCY RETIMER WITH SEAMLESS CLOCK SWITCHOVER granted 2023-12-26, MEMORY CONTROL COMPONENT WITH SPLIT AUXILIARY CHANNEL, CAPACITY-EXPANDING MEMORY CONTROL COMPONENT, DIMM SLOT TERMINATOR, BGA PCB anti-pad). Multiple pre-Feb-2024 grants consistent with the disclosed 8 issued patents.
scores.interpretation: USPTO independently corroborates a real, on-thesis IP portfolio in interconnect/memory-control/PCB-package technology. The disclosed count (8 issued / 24 pending) is consistent with — if anything conservative relative to — the application pipeline. No Nikola-pattern gap (claimed tech area is the dominant category, 28/36). Honest disclosure.

scores.claim_text: Astera issued a performance-vesting Customer Warrant to Amazon NV Investment Holdings LLC (Oct 2022, up to 1,484,230 shares @ $20.34), implying Amazon/AWS is a material hyperscaler customer.
scores.M_check: megacap_namecheck(Astera Labs; Amazon/Microsoft/Nvidia) + edgar_fts('Astera Labs', cik=Amazon 0001018724)
scores.M_value: 0 mentions of 'Astera Labs' in Amazon's 10-K/10-Q/8-K (and 0 in Microsoft/Nvidia); megacap signal=INFLATION_SUSPECT.
scores.interpretation: Apply Calibration H4 (strategic/customer warrant != separately-disclosable counterparty obligation) and H5 (a hyperscaler buyer of a connectivity-chip vendor would not name it in its own filings; buyer non-disclosure is expected and non-informative). Critically, the warrant itself is NOT a marketing claim — it is a real SEC-registered instrument booked as contra-revenue in Astera's PwC-audited financial statements (232,608 shares vested as of 12/31/23), so the relationship is internally evidenced. The INFLATION_SUSPECT flag here is a known false-positive pattern for B2B megacap-supplier names below 10-K customer-disclosure thresholds; it does NOT contradict the audited warrant. No independent registry corroborates or refutes -> honestly UNVERIFIABLE, not SEVERE.

scores.claim_text: Astera collaborates with leading data-center infrastructure suppliers including NVIDIA, AMD, and Intel; products designed/validated into their ecosystems.
scores.M_value: 0 mentions of 'Astera Labs' in NVIDIA filings; 0 in Intel filings.
scores.interpretation: Claim is framed as ecosystem collaboration / interop validation, not a named revenue contract (H4: investment/collaboration relationships are not material counterparty obligations the partner must disclose). NVIDIA/Intel are infrastructure suppliers Astera interoperates with, not buyers who would name a retimer vendor in their 10-K. Absence in their filings is expected and non-informative, not a contradiction. No registry records 'collaboration' relationships of this type -> UNVERIFIABLE.

scores.claim_text: Astera has achieved more than 300 design wins and is a proven supplier to hyperscaler and system-OEM customers.
scores.M_value: 3 external SEC-filer mentions pre-cutoff: Marvell Technology 10-K (FY2023 filed 2023-03-09 AND FY2024 filed 2024-03-13) and Digital Realty Trust DEF 14A (2023-04-28). Marvell names Astera as a connectivity-semiconductor market participant/competitor in two consecutive 10-Ks.
scores.interpretation: No federal registry counts 'design wins' — it is an internal commercial metric (H8-type: not in any registry). However the unrestricted EDGAR FTS independently confirms Astera Labs is a real, externally-recognized connectivity-semi participant (a competitor, Marvell, cites it by name in successive annual reports), which is consistent with — though it does not quantify — the claimed 300+ design wins and proven-supplier status. No way to verify or refute the specific count -> UNVERIFIABLE (no manufactured severity; the directional evidence is corroborative, not contradictory).

scores.claim_text: Revenue is highly concentrated: top-3 end customers ~89% (2022) and ~70% (2023); one customer was a majority of 2022 revenue; largest distributor 82% (2022) / 37% (2023).
scores.M_value: signal=UNVERIFIABLE — connector is designed for federal-services-prime IDIQ vehicle/task-order concentration, not commercial semis customer concentration (its own note: the SEC 10% customer-disclosure rule already governs non-government customer concentration).
scores.interpretation: Category mismatch: no federal registry adjudicates commercial customer concentration for a fabless semi company. The honesty-framework reading is the salient one — Astera AFFIRMATIVELY and quantitatively discloses an extreme, true concentration risk (a majority of 2022 revenue from a single customer; top-3 89%->70%; distributor 82%->37%) plus a disclosed material weakness in ICFR. This is candid disclosure of a genuine risk, not a masked or inflated claim, so it carries no underdelivery severity. Scored UNVERIFIABLE per sector-registry-match discipline (no registry covers it) rather than manufacturing severity against an honestly disclosed negative.

scores.claim_text: Astera discloses material weaknesses in ICFR; financials are PwC-audited (clean opinion, auditor since 2021), solvent at IPO (FY23 revenue $115.8M, net loss $26.3M narrowing from $58.3M, liquidity $149.3M, 'sufficient for at least 12 months').
scores.M_value: signal=NO_GOING_CONCERN (0 substantial-doubt matches). [Detector resolved to the most recent 10-K available; the NO_GOING_CONCERN result is consistent with the at-IPO audited statements: $149.3M cash+marketable securities, working capital $150.7M, net loss narrowing 58.3M->26.3M, management 12-month sufficiency assertion.]
scores.interpretation: Honest-disclosure PASS on the financial-distress axis. Astera candidly discloses its ICFR material weakness in the risk factors (a true negative, disclosed not masked) while presenting a clean PwC audit opinion and a solvent, improving-loss balance sheet with no going-concern language. The going-concern check corroborates solvency. Candid disclosure of a real weakness alongside audited solvency is exactly the honesty signal the framework rewards (re-detecting an honestly disclosed weakness is not underdelivery). PASS.
